acceptance: Ratio of median JSON with owned native UTF-8 bytes time to public MSGPACK time; encode and decode separately, unchanged 18-workload set, both ABIs. Warmed throughput is the acceptance gate. First call, string-only JSON, size and memory are separate reports.

memoryLimits.rssUnit: KiB on Android; entire process including setup and validation, not codec-only peak
memoryLimits.heapAndExternalUnit: bytes; retained graph/output included, native allocator/page slack not included in V8 external-byte accounting
memoryLimits.arm32MappingTail: less than one allocation page after successful trim; if ReleasePages fails the original mapping extent is preserved and correctly freed

bootstrap: 5000 paired-round resamples, percentile 95% interval of ratio of medians, seed 20261005; descriptive, not a guarantee on other devices.
scopeLimits: Warmup is required for the all-workload 1.5x result; first-call misses are retained.
JSON string-only timing is reported separately from equivalent binary transport.
Raw and gzip MessagePack sizes can exceed JSON without changing the supported lossless value profile.
Tested rooted OnePlus 6, f0 affinity, NDK 27.3.13750724; other devices and build configurations require measurement.
